headline: Mariners top Phillies 4-1 as Nola takes tough loss
recap: Aaron Nola allowed two runs over six strong innings but was saddled with the loss as the Phillies fell 4-1 to the Mariners on Tuesday, dropping the second game of their three-game series in Seattle. Bryson Stott scored Philadelphia's only run in the second inning on a Justin Crawford single, but Josh Naylor answered right back with an RBI single in the bottom half. George Kirby held the Phillies to that one run over 7.2 innings, Cal Raleigh added a solo home run in the sixth, and Dominic Canzone's two-run single off reliever Orion Kerkering in the seventh put it away. Andres Munoz worked around two walks to close it out for the save.
The loss was Philadelphia's second straight. The Phillies are 73-60, in second place in the NL East, 4.5 games behind the first-place Atlanta Braves.

Philadelphia closes out the series finale against Seattle on Wednesday, with Jesus Luzardo facing Mariners right-hander Bryan Woo; first pitch at T-Mobile Park is scheduled for 4:10 PM ET. The Phillies are off Thursday before opening a three-game series against the Angels on Friday.
